title: Sparkly key
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Key shaft -->
  <rect x="30" y="45" width="45" height="10" rx="3" fill="#FFD700" stroke="#FFEF80" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Key bow (handle) - circle with hole -->
  <circle cx="22" cy="50" r="16" fill="#FFB800" stroke="#FFE066" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="50" r="7" fill="#1a1a3a" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Key teeth -->
  <rect x="65" y="52" width="8" height="10" rx="1.5" fill="#FFC200" stroke="#FFE066" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="75" y="52" width="8" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#FFC200" stroke="#FFE066" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="85" y="52" width="6" height="4" rx="1.5" fill="#FFC200" stroke="#FFE066" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Key highlight -->
  <rect x="35" y="47" width="25" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#FFEF80" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Sparkle 1 - top left -->
  <path d="M15 20 L17 12 L19 20 L27 22 L19 24 L17 32 L15 24 L7 22 Z" fill="#FF6EC7" stroke="#FFA8E0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <!-- Sparkle 2 - top right -->
  <path d="M82 10 L84 5 L86 10 L91 12 L86 14 L84 19 L82 14 L77 12 Z" fill="#7DF9FF" stroke="#B8FDFF" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <!-- Sparkle 3 - bottom left small -->
  <path d="M10 78 L11.5 73 L13 78 L18 79.5 L13 81 L11.5 86 L10 81 L5 79.5 Z" fill="#ADFF2F" stroke="#D4FF80" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  <!-- Sparkle 4 - bottom right -->
  <path d="M88 72 L90 65 L92 72 L99 74 L92 76 L90 83 L88 76 L81 74 Z" fill="#FF6EC7" stroke="#FFA8E0" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <!-- Sparkle 5 - top center small dot -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="12" r="3" fill="#7DF9FF" stroke="#B8FDFF" stroke-width="0.5"/>
  <!-- Sparkle 6 - right small -->
  <circle cx="95" cy="45" r="2.5" fill="#ADFF2F" stroke="#D4FF80" stroke-width="0.5"/>
  <!-- Sparkle 7 - left small -->
  <circle cx="5" cy="42" r="2" fill="#FFB800" stroke="#FFE066" stroke-width="0.5"/>
  <!-- Small star accents -->
  <path d="M45 85 L46.5 81 L48 85 L52 86.5 L48 88 L46.5 92 L45 88 L41 86.5 Z" fill="#FFEF80" stroke="#FFF8C0" stroke-width="0.6"/>
  <path d="M60 75 L61.5 71 L63 75 L67 76.5 L63 78 L61.5 82 L60 78 L56 76.5 Z" fill="#7DF9FF" stroke="#B8FDFF" stroke-width="0.6"/>
</svg>
